system.description:
You collect wind release chakra and infuse it into your Medical Release technique. One willing creature within range breathes in this Medically infused wind.

For the duration a creature who has breathed this wind does not need to breathe, and if you would gain ranks of a Physical condition, you reduce the ranks gained by 1, for the duration.

Additionally, when they would regain hit points, they regain an additional +4 Hit points.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the bonus hit point regained by +4.
